tokens.name: bg-sidebar
tokens.usage: Navigation sidebar. In dark it is the deepest layer; in light it is white with a border-default edge.

tokens.name: bg-ground
tokens.usage: Page background behind all cards.

tokens.name: bg-raised
tokens.usage: Table header rows and sub-panels inside a card.

tokens.name: bg-surface
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, inputs sit on this. Must stay visibly lighter than bg-ground in dark.

tokens.name: border-default
tokens.usage: Card edges, table row dividers, hairlines.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Input borders and secondary button borders.

tokens.name: text-primary
tokens.usage: Main text and numbers on any bg- token.

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Nav items and dates; one step quieter than text-primary.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Labels, captions, table headers, helper text. Passes 4.5:1 on bg-surface and bg-ground.

tokens.name: action
tokens.usage: Primary button fill (on-action text on it), focus ring, selected input border, chart primary line.

tokens.name: action-text
tokens.usage: Links and icons in the action colour on bg- tokens.

tokens.name: action-subtle
tokens.usage: Active nav item background, info badge background, selected row.

tokens.name: on-action
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an action fill (primary button).

tokens.name: profit
tokens.usage: Positive P&L numbers, up moves, success dots. Only ever means gain or success.

tokens.name: profit-subtle
tokens.usage: Background of success badges (Connected, Done, Completed).

tokens.name: profit-text
tokens.usage: Text on profit-subtle.

tokens.name: loss
tokens.usage: Negative P&L, charges, down moves, error dots, danger button border. Only ever means loss or failure.

tokens.name: loss-subtle
tokens.usage: Background of error badges and alert bars (Token expired, Failed).

tokens.name: loss-text
tokens.usage: Text on loss-subtle.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Near-limit meters and warning icons.

tokens.name: warning-subtle
tokens.usage: Background of the Demo data banner and warning badges.

tokens.name: warning-text
tokens.usage: Text on warning-subtle.

tokens.name: chart-benchmark
tokens.usage: Dashed benchmark line (NIFTY 50) in charts. Never used for text.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Strategy runs on NIFTY 50 constituents, delivery only.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase labels on stat cards and table headers (apply text-transform: uppercase).

styles.name: number
styles.usage: Prices, quantities and P&L in tables. Always right-aligned.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text nudges.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap inside badges and label/value pairs.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between buttons and table columns.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding (small cards), grid gaps between cards.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding (large cards), table row side padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Main content side padding.

tokens.name: space-14
tokens.usage: Page padding on documentation boards.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Progress and meter bars.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, nav items, banners.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and panels.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status badges.

tokens.name: control-height
tokens.usage: Buttons and inputs.

tokens.name: nav-item-height
tokens.usage: Sidebar links.

tokens.name: sidebar-width
tokens.usage: Both apps' left navigation.
